status: 100-collection acquisition cohort frozen; two train scenes annotated, one evaluated; independent evaluation pending
independence_unit: capture collection plus sampled 5 km geographic neighborhood
do_not_use_for_tuning: test groups, including all later frames from those collections
annotation_requirements: Per-frame vehicle, privacy-blurred, moving-object and visible-road masks
Verified road surface, markings, curvature, grade, light, rig size and source blur classes
Freeze hidden ground masks before any method comparison
Flag incomplete windows, spherical seams, non-planar structures and uncertain ground
evaluation: Candidate coverage and abstention on true car masks, explicitly without ground-truth accuracy claims
Large and local withheld visible-road patches; masked pixels excluded before every feature/tracking/pose operation
Both equal-route and pooled error/coverage, with spatial block error and boundary alignment
Same-pixel controls plus coverage-error curves; report failures rather than dropping scenes
Synthetic calibrated scenes with known poses and full hidden ground truth, reported separately from real captures
Measure viewpoint and source sampling resolution so grazing-angle texture limits are visible
promotion: No promotion from donor agreement or pooled pixel counts alone. Require converged geometry, per-road quality checks, no integrity/split failures, and a frozen independent evaluation after development decisions.
known_limitation: Withheld visible road is a proxy; it does not reveal the road physically occluded by the actual target camera vehicle. No real under-car reconstruction success rate has been established.
